captions.detailed: This 3D model is a rectangular enclosure box designed to hold an LCD screen. It features a solid bottom faceplate with a large rectangular cutout in the center to expose the screen, surrounded by four upright sidewalls that form an open-top compartment. The walls are of uniform thickness, creating a protective shell around the perimeter of the display area.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric LCD holder box in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the overall length, width, and wall height of the box, as well as the dimensions of the rectangular screen cutout (screen length and screen width), wall thickness, and an option to generate a matching bottom cover plate.
captions.factory: The code defines a main 'lcdbox' module which is composed of three sub-modules: 'holder' (a flat bottom plate created using cube), 'screen' (a solid cube representing the cutout volume, translated to the center), and 'sidewalls' (created by taking the difference of a larger outer cube and a smaller inner cube). These parts are combined using a union of the hollowed sidewalls and the difference between the holder plate and the screen cutout. An optional 'lcdbottom' module generates a separate, stepped cover plate using two stacked cubes translated to the side, controlled by a conditional check on the 'generate_top' variable.
